rules.description: DISABLED FOR NOW (per request) - re-enable by removing "enabled": false. Omang / Birth Certificate must be exactly 9 numeric digits. Passport format varies by country - no digit validation.

Passport.message: Passport format not validated - varies by country of origin

rules.description: Derive gender from the 5th digit of Omang/Birth Certificate number. 1=Male, 2=Female. Applies to APPFORM and KYC only.

ID Expiry Date must be in the future relative to processing date. Skip entirely if ID Type = Birth Certificate. This field is only ever read off the KYC form; on every other form it is absent until backfilled from a sibling KYC document for the same investor (see SHAREABLE_FIELDS in consolidator.py) - the rule still applies wherever the value ends up.
Date of Birth must be a valid date in the past. Applies to APPFORM and KYC.
Must match standard email format (contains @ and a valid domain).

Numeric. Botswana numbers are commonly 8 digits (local) or 9 digits (with a leading trunk/prefix digit such as 0). Both 8 and 9 digit numbers are valid and must NOT raise a warning. Any other length is flagged.
Bank branch code must be exactly 6 digits per BIFM requirements.
Minor's full name, guardian name and guardian Omang are required only when Account Type = Acting on Behalf of. APPFORM only.
Parent/Guardian Omang: 9-digit validation applies. APPFORM only.
SMS notification preference defaults to YES if blank. APPFORM only.
Marketing communication preference defaults to YES if blank. APPFORM only.
Communication channel defaults to EMAIL if blank. APPFORM only.
Beneficiary split percentages must total 100%. APPFORM only.
All 4 KYC document checkboxes (Certified ID, Proof of Address, Proof of Banking, Proof of Source) must be ticked. KYC only.

BIFM fund/entity numbers are commonly 8 or 9 digits, extracted from the handwritten row of the Core Fund Range table (see fund_category_present rule for the related fund_name check). Both lengths are valid - no warning is raised for either. Only a non-numeric or clearly implausible value is flagged.
Fund category (MM/NMM/GSGF) and processing cut-off must be determinable from the extracted fund name. ADD, DEBIT, DIS, DIS_GSG only.

Instruction mode must resolve to Full Closure, Percentage, or Partial Withdrawal. Full Closure is set by the close-account tick at the foot of the form; Percentage by a value in the disinvestment percentage column; Partial Withdrawal by an amount in the deposit/withdrawal amount column. If none of the three signals is found the form needs manual review. DIS, DIS_GSG only.
